items.title: Implement fix for reproduced failure
items.userSees: The story transcript shows pre-story red/repro/spike evidence and a full M5-M12 milestone ledger before DEV begins.

happy.desc: Pre-story repro review and confirmed spike are recorded before development starts.

edge.desc: The story retains all M5-M12 derived checklist refs and does not collapse to one generic fix item.

adversarial.desc: Candidate evidence remains evidence-candidate and is not treated as verificationEvidence or DONE proof.

items.title: M5 wire handoff and host entry runtime memory consumers
items.context: Handoff and host dispatch must consume the shared MemoryFreshnessPack, show packDigest/top IDs, surface Codex+Claude primary host policy, and keep agy-cli fallback-only with concrete fallback reasons.
items.userSees: handoff_create / handoff_resume output includes Memory Runtime Preflight with packDigest, host policy hits, and agy fallback status only when a primary host failure is present.

happy.desc: Codex/Claude primary host policy surfaces in handoff output with packDigest and top hit IDs.

edge.desc: agy fallback is rendered only with unavailable/quota/timed-out/substituted primary-host status.

adversarial.desc: handoff output never treats memory pack as gate evidence or release readiness.

items.title: M6 wire story intake and lifecycle runtime memory consumers
items.context: story_create/repro-first intake and story_advance must surface phase-appropriate active playbooks without letting unregistered memory content create blocking policy rows.
items.userSees: story_create and story_advance show advisory Memory Runtime Preflight for relevant code-verifiable/repro-first/lifecycle lessons while non-code stories avoid irrelevant blocking.

happy.desc: Code-verifiable story surfaces repro-first playbook guidance in story intake/lifecycle output.

edge.desc: Document-only story does not receive irrelevant blocking memory guidance.

adversarial.desc: Unregistered active playbook content cannot set or escalate blocking lifecycle policy.

items.title: M7 wire DONE closure and final-response advisory memory consumers
items.context: done_prepare/done_closure/final response check must show active intent-totality and delivery lessons, but full-completion claims must be checked against ParentRollupResult/current structured facts.
items.userSees: done_prepare / done_closure output says advisory memory considered and points full-roadmap claims to ParentRollupResult instead of claiming memory proved DONE.

happy.desc: DONE closure surfaces parent-roadmap totality lesson and delivery lesson when relevant.

edge.desc: Partial parent rollup cannot be rendered as full-roadmap complete.

adversarial.desc: DONE closure still relies on structured DONE/ParentRollup evidence, not memory pack text.

items.title: M9 add deterministic million-record playbook memory baseline generator
items.context: Add small and full profile generator with seeded manifest, stable digest, gold queries, corrupt-row fixtures, gitignored runtime output, and materialHash-safe defaults.
items.userSees: memory_playbook_baseline_generate reports exactly 1,000,000 records in full profile, stable manifest digest, and project-local output safety.

happy.desc: Full profile generates exactly 1,000,000 deterministic records and a manifest.

edge.desc: Same seed yields same digest; corrupt rows are included for reader skip tests.

adversarial.desc: Generated payloads do not dirty materialHash or story evidence by default.

items.title: M10 add million-record correctness and performance verifier
items.context: Verifier must check recall@10, current-over-superseded preference, false-surface rates, stale detection, line cap, peak memory budget, and report-first performance metrics.
items.userSees: memory_playbook_baseline_verify passes correctness thresholds and prints latency/RSS/index timing without enforcing premature performance budget failure.

happy.desc: Correctness thresholds pass for small and full profiles.

edge.desc: Performance is recorded but report-first unless rollout config requires enforcement.

adversarial.desc: Line cap and stale detection still hold under generated large corpus.

items.title: P3-enforce add registered warn/enforce rollout policy after baseline correctness
items.context: Warn/enforce behavior must only activate for registered critical consumers after 1M correctness baseline passes; advisory remains default and memory stays non-authoritative.
items.userSees: Rollout config can show advisory, warn, or registered blocking state; default output stays advisory and says gateEvidence:false.

happy.desc: Registered critical consumer can warn/enforce only after baseline correctness evidence.

edge.desc: Default mode remains advisory and non-authoritative.

adversarial.desc: Memory/playbook content alone cannot self-register as blocking policy.

items.title: M8 add capture-or-noop end-of-work memory decision
items.context: Add a lightweight command/reminder that records captured, no-reusable-lesson, or defer-with-reason without auto-promoting story candidates to project/global memory.
items.userSees: At end of work, playbook memory decision output shows captured/no-reusable-lesson/deferred state and keeps candidates non-authoritative.

happy.desc: Captured decision creates a story-scoped candidate/reminder without gate authority.

edge.desc: No-op decision is accepted only with a reason.

adversarial.desc: No automatic promotion to project/global active memory occurs.

items.title: M11 add project-configurable playbook runtime health and drift scanner
items.context: Add playbook_runtime_health or dev_memory_health checking configured required memory classes, active playbooks, deprecated current brand guidance, consumer wiring, and baseline availability.
items.userSees: playbook_runtime_health reports PASS on clean repo and explains missing configured runtime memory, consumer drift, or deprecated guidance failures.

happy.desc: Health passes with configured host-policy/truth-first/parent-roadmap memory classes present.

edge.desc: Configured required memory classes are project-local config, not global hard-coded requirements.

adversarial.desc: Health fails if session/handoff/story/DONE consumers stop including runtime pack.

items.title: M12 finalize rollout runbook and Codex/Claude 3x2 verification with agy fallback only
items.context: Document/operator rollout must show advisory -> warn -> registered blocking stages, Codex+Claude primary 3x2 digest parity, and agy fallback only when primary host unavailable/quota-limited.
items.userSees: Final verification table shows M5-M12 complete, Codex/Claude digest parity or stale classification, agy fallback-only semantics, and no memory-as-evidence confusion.

happy.desc: Codex CLI and Claude Code CLI agree on pack digest/top hit IDs or report explicit stale drift.

edge.desc: agy-cli fallback path reports the concrete primary-host failure signal.

adversarial.desc: No rollout or verification text treats memory as proof evidence.
